decisions.decision: Call volume sweep 'VCA ramp' in user-facing contexts
decisions.rationale: Sweep is Sony register jargon, meaningless to musicians

decisions.decision: Raw unfiltered noise only — no Gauss filter option
decisions.rationale: Noise-through-Gauss experiment showed darkening but nothing a filter couldn't do; keep PS1-faithful

decisions.decision: Noise Color knob (0-15) controls LFSR shift rate in real time
decisions.rationale: Global SPUCNT parameter exposed as a per-session control

decisions.decision: Pan/Level fader are static controls; VCA ramp is modulation layer — don't tie fader to ramp
decisions.rationale: Ramp will eventually loop (tremolo/auto-pan), a fader chasing it would be jittery

decisions.decision: Voice Dynamics & Stereo Effects is a separate future milestone
decisions.rationale: Tremolo, auto-pan, sidechain duck, stereo widener, AM synthesis, phase modulator deferred
